title: Quantum Pauli basis test
abstract: A Lean 4 formalization of the quantum Pauli basis test from MIP*=RE. The comparator-configured results give a value-one symmetric projective consistent commuting strategy, quantum soundness of the simultaneous low-degree test, soundness of the Pauli basis test up to local isometries with the explicit deltaQld error, and the corresponding qubit-coordinate form.
